# Centro Papelero

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Office and stationery distributor in Uruguay with an online store. Sells office supplies, school supplies, art supplies, paper products and toys. States delivery across the country within 24 hours of dispatch on business days, and free delivery in Montevideo above a stated amount.
